name: ATVITA
author: BM-Hicham19
description: This is not a rewrite of the game. It is a small Dalvik virtual machine written in C (src/vm.c, ~800 lines) that runs the game's own classes.dex on the Vita, plus native implementations of the ~250 Android / Java calls the game makes (src/jlib.c, src/droid.c): a software canvas, bitmaps, PNG decoding, streams, strings, input, file storage. Game code, art and levels come from your own APK; nothing from the game is in this repository or in the VPK.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
